name: new_game
description: The boot and the title, then New Game: OPEN_runUserRegistration's pages (the sound and polygon-battle settings at their defaults), the name entry (the one-letter name 'A'), the Veemon starter deck, the 'tell me about the game' pages, the save to a fresh memory card's File 1, and the fade into SAISEG, Beginner City. Checkpoints at the title menu, the accepted name, the chosen starter and SAISEG loaded. Dialogs whose cursor starts on No (initDialog's default: the name, the deck, the new file) get an explicit LEFT; the others are confirmed with the default.

steps.comment: PLAYER_PROFILES allocated by initPlayerData, at the address probes.lua hashes
OPENSEG loaded (its first word, the overlay id 8): the opening movie's overlay
OPEN_TITLE_STATE 6: the logo's animation is over and 'PRESS START' blinks (open_title.c states 6-7)
START opens the menu (OPEN_TITLE_STATE 8)
the menu's fade-in (state 8 ignores the pad while the fade runs)
the cursor from Continue (choice 1) to New Game (0)
confirm New Game: OPEN_runUserRegistration
through the greeting, the sound and polygon-battle dialogs (their default is the first option) to the name entry (OPEN_INTRO_TEXT.step 1)
the letter under the cursor (A) as the name's first character
jump to the side menu's OK
OK: 'Is this name OK?' opens, its cursor on No (initDialog's default)
the cursor to Yes
Yes: the name is accepted (step 2)
the partner pages (2-4), the starter select (step 3) and its prompt (page 5): the first press once that text is shown puts the deck list under the pad (page 6: Veemon under the cursor)
choose the deck under the cursor: 'Is this deck OK?' opens, its cursor on No (initDialog's default)
the cursor to Yes
Yes
the starter deck is given and the registration goes on (step 4)

through the rest of the registration (its Yes/No dialogs default to Yes; the longer 'tell me about the game' path) to the save screen's file select (OPEN_MEMCARD.state 3: the fresh card read, 15 free blocks)
File 1: 'Creating a Digital Card Battle File. Is this OK?' opens, its cursor on No
the cursor to Yes
Yes: the save is written (state 4, then 25)
'Save complete' (state 12) waits for a press
the message settles

close the save screen (state 12 waits for CROSS), then the last page ('Enjoy Digital Card Battle!', kind 11 ends the registration on a press once its text is shown); runTitleMenu loads SAISEG (overlay id 6) and starts SAI_runArea: Beginner City
